title: What's new
subtitle: The latest improvements to the app.

invitations-hardening.title: Team invitations tightened
invitations-hardening.body: An invitation now stays valid only while the person who sent it can still invite: if they leave the organization or are no longer an admin, it stops working and shows as "No longer valid", and you can invite the address again. Signing up from an invitation keeps the invited address, and we hardened how names are shown in the app and in emails.

role-access-tightened.title: We tightened who keeps access to a role
role-access-tightened.body: Leaving a role's team, or your organization, now ends everything that came with that place on the team. Someone who comes back sees no role until they are added to its team again. New roles also get a short random ending in their link.

candidate-emails-job-title.title: Candidate emails name the role by its job title only
candidate-emails-job-title.body: The invitation and the confirmation a candidate receives now name the role only by the job title shown to candidates. A role without one is described as an interview with your organisation, never by the name your team uses for it. We also hardened how uploaded files are tracked, so deleting a candidate, a question or a role removes every file that belongs to it, and tightened the protections on the candidate's interview link.

share-highlights-and-deadlines.title: Highlights on shared reports, no dead invitations
share-highlights-and-deadlines.body: A shared report now lists the moments worth watching, as the report in the app does. A bounced invitation is flagged on its candidate however much mail the organisation sent since. A role past its deadline, or archived, no longer sends invitations or reminders that would open on a closed interview, and when a role's creator leaves with nobody else on its team, its admins are told when a report is ready.

assistant-history-purged.title: Older assistant conversations deleted
assistant-history-purged.body: As part of tightening how candidate data is deleted, your conversations with the assistant from before this update have been deleted. From now on, deleting a candidate also deletes every conversation in which the assistant read their data.

auth-hardening-sep-25.title: Sign-in hardened
auth-hardening-sep-25.body: We hardened sign-in and team invitations against misuse, and reserved administrator access to the operator's own address. Completing an email verification link now only asks for the password you chose, so you never lose it along the way.

removed-members-credit.title: Removed teammates keep their credit
removed-members-credit.body: When you remove someone from your organization, the decisions they made, their entries in a candidate's decision history, the invitations they sent and the roles they created still show their name, greyed out and marked "(removed)", instead of disappearing. A teammate whose account was deleted shows as "Former member". The platform's last super admin can no longer delete their account by mistake.

calmer-interface.title: A calmer, more consistent interface
calmer-interface.body: Interw now uses its own typeface everywhere, respects your system's reduce-motion setting, and shows the shape of the page while it loads instead of a line of text. Candidate search (⌘K) opens as a list you can move through with the arrow keys, and is reachable from a phone. Dates follow the language of the app, the roles list marks the ones whose team you are on, and importing a job ad adds all of it or none of it.

candidate-leave-guard.title: Candidates are warned before losing an answer
candidate-leave-guard.body: A candidate who presses Back or closes the tab while an answer is recording, sending, or waiting to be retried is now asked first, and if they leave anyway the interview's log says so, so a missing answer no longer looks like a skipped one. A link opened without https now says so instead of blaming the browser, each interview screen has its own page title, and we tightened what our error reports keep from report share links.

data-correctness.title: Honest counts, and invitations that close on time
data-correctness.body: The dashboard no longer shrinks its figures as your organisation grows: a number that reached our counting limit now shows as “400+”. Invitations to a role whose deadline passed more than a day ago are marked expired. A resend to an address that bounced is refused instead of sent again, and a bounce can no longer flip back to “sent”. Two roles with the same title always get distinct links.

backend-hardening.title: Tighter limits around links and uploads
backend-hardening.body: We hardened what a candidate link, a report share link and file uploads can do: expiry and time checks rely only on our servers, upload windows and sizes now match each question's length, and share links follow the same rate limits as the rest of the product. On a shared report, an answer recorded without a camera now plays as audio instead of a black video, and the internal role name is never shown.

assistant-panel.title: A lighter, quieter assistant panel
assistant-panel.body: The AI assistant now stays closed until you open it, and loads only then, so recruiter pages open faster. On a phone or a narrow window it opens as a proper dialog you can leave with Escape or a tap outside. The composer shows how long your message is against the 8,000-character limit, and says so plainly when it is too long. We also tightened which links and images the assistant's answers can point to.

recruiter-routes.title: Clearer errors, safer publishing
recruiter-routes.body: A mistyped or deleted link now shows a clear page inside the app with a way back to your roles, and refused actions tell you why. A role can no longer be published with the example question or an unnamed criterion, and you can delete a role created by mistake. Downloaded CVs and cover letters are named in your language.

candidate-page.title: A candidate page that keeps up with you
candidate-page.body: Videos no longer restart when you save a note, and keep playing after an hour on the page; if a recording cannot load, you are told and can retry. The moments worth watching sit under the player, decisions keep their history, and when an analysis does not finish, the role's creator or an admin can relaunch it. Revoking a share link now asks first, and the cover letter has its own button.

candidate-table.title: Compare candidates at a glance
candidate-table.body: The candidate table now shows each candidate's score and AI recommendation. Sort by score, recommendation, date or length, and filter by status or by your decision. An invitation that bounced or was marked as spam is flagged on its row, and owners, admins and the role's creator can copy a candidate's link to send it themselves. When you paste a list, repeated addresses are shown before anything is sent.

video-intro.title: Film your intro, replay your questions
video-intro.body: You can now film a short video intro for a role from its Basics step: candidates see it before the first question. The intro is a video or nothing — written and audio intros are gone, and a role that had one now opens straight on its first question. Every question you record now plays back right where you recorded it, and a recording made without a camera plays as audio for you and for candidates.

role-team.title: Choose who follows each role
role-team.body: Each role now has a team: you, plus the colleagues you pick when you create it or later from Team. The team sees the role and gets the email when a candidate's report is ready — nobody else in your organisation is emailed any more. Admins and owners still see every role. A role that was open to everyone is now visible to its creator, admins and owners until you add its team.

evaluation-hardening.title: AI evaluation, hardened
evaluation-hardening.body: We hardened how reports are produced: what a candidate says, and the text of an imported job ad, are always treated as material to assess. A report now covers every answer the candidate gave, or is produced again, and it no longer has to name a strength the interview did not show.

delivery-figures-removed.title: Delivery figures removed from reports
delivery-figures-removed.body: Reports no longer include the Delivery section (speaking rate, hesitation, silence and the rest). Those figures were not reliable enough to inform a hiring decision, so we removed them. Scores, evidence, answers and recordings are unchanged, including on reports you have already received.

interview-survives-crash.title: An answer survives a crash, and candidates can hear themselves first
interview-survives-crash.body: While a candidate answers, the recording is now also kept on their device: if the page crashes or is closed, reopening the link sends the answer instead of losing it. They also see a live microphone meter while they talk — with a warning if we stop hearing them — and the check screen tells them when their camera shows only black and lets them record a short test to hear themselves before starting.

recordings-play-everywhere.title: Answers that play everywhere, and a phone that stays awake
recordings-play-everywhere.body: Answers recorded in Chrome, Edge or Safari now use a format every browser plays, iPhones included, so jumping to a quote in a report lands where it should. A phone no longer locks its screen mid-answer, a microphone taken by a call ends the answer cleanly instead of recording silence, and when an answer's video could not be sent you still hear what the candidate said.

delete-organization.title: Delete an organization
delete-organization.body: An organization's owner can now delete it from its settings, after typing its name to confirm. Every role, candidate recording, CV, transcript, report and assistant conversation in it is erased for good, and its members are told by email. Being the only owner of an organization no longer stands between you and deleting your account: delete the organization first, and your account is free to go.

clearer-account-settings.title: Clearer account settings
clearer-account-settings.body: Your profile now follows an email change step by step, shows the ways you can really sign in, and lets you set a password if your account has none. An account-deletion link opened on another device now leads to a clear page, and an account can no longer leave an organization without an owner. We also hardened our security notices: you now get an email after a password reset too.

sign-in-with-a-code.title: Sign in with a code from your email
sign-in-with-a-code.body: Enter your email and we send you a 6-digit code — or a button that fills it in for you. The same steps create your account, so there is no password to choose; you can still sign in with one if you have it. Invitations use the same sign-in, and a session that expires now brings you back to the page you were on.

verification-link-guidance.title: Clearer email verification
verification-link-guidance.body: Opening a verification link while signed in to another account, or after it has expired, now tells you what to do next instead of leaving you on a plain sign-in page. Sign-up also asks you to type your password twice.

team-invitations.title: Smoother team invitations
team-invitations.body: Invite several teammates at once, see who invited whom and when, resend an invitation or copy its link, and spot an email that bounced. Expired invitations are marked as such and can be sent again. People who sign up without the link now see the invitation waiting for them instead of creating a second organization, and anyone can create another organization from the organization menu. The invitation email now says which role you are offered and until when.

sturdier-interview.title: A sturdier interview for your candidates
sturdier-interview.body: Candidates now see themselves while they record, can carry on with audio alone when their camera is taken by another app, watch their answers upload, and see what is missing before they finish. The interview speaks your role's language whatever their browser's, and they get an email when it reaches you — with a link to see or delete their data. We also hardened how their interview links are handled in our error monitoring.

verification-needs-password.title: Confirming your email now asks for your password
verification-needs-password.body: We strengthened email verification: after clicking the link, you now sign in with your password to confirm your address. That way a verification link can only ever complete an account you set up yourself.

job-import-pinned.title: Job-ad import, hardened
job-import-pinned.body: We hardened how job-ad imports reach the web: each page is now fetched only from the address we checked.

erasure-reaches-copies.title: Deleting a candidate reaches every copy
erasure-reaches-copies.body: We hardened candidate data deletion: when a candidate’s data is erased, the copies kept by our email and assistant services go too — assistant conversations that read it immediately, email copies automatically within 30 days at most.

candidate-interview-hardening.title: A closed interview stays closed, and a deletion is complete
candidate-interview-hardening.body: We hardened the candidate interview. A cancelled or closed invitation now stays closed at every step, including the last one. The delivery figures in a report are now computed only from what our own systems measured. And deleting a candidate’s data now removes every recording they made, including an answer re-recorded from another browser.

team-access-hardening.title: Confidential roles stay confidential, and removal ends access
team-access-hardening.body: We tightened who can see and act on confidential roles, and made sure that removing a teammate fully ends their access to your organisation — including the emails they receive about candidates. Restoring an archived role now takes the same rights as archiving it.

assistant-images-and-role-actions.title: Safer assistant replies, clearer role actions
assistant-images-and-role-actions.body: We hardened the assistant: images in its replies are no longer loaded, only described. And a role’s Share, Archive and Restore actions are now offered only to the people who can use them.

abuse-hardening.title: Hardened against misuse
abuse-hardening.body: We hardened the AI assistant, job-ad import, account notifications and shared report links against misuse, so they stay fast and fair for everyone.

assistant-in-europe.title: The assistant runs in Europe too
assistant-in-europe.body: The assistant that answers your questions about roles and candidates now runs on the same French provider as interview transcription and assessment. It reads reports in order to answer you, so what you ask it about a candidate is interview data like any other — and it belongs under the same guarantee: one provider, one destination, and nothing about a candidate leaving it.

role-authoring-fixes.title: Adding questions, and importing ads that are not plain pages
role-authoring-fixes.body: Two fixes to building a role. “Add a question” now opens an editable card instead of refusing with “a question must contain text” before you had a chance to type any. And importing from a job ad works on boards that render their ads in the browser — Welcome to the Jungle, Indeed, ATS career pages — which previously came back as “not enough text on that page”. When a site refuses to be read by anything but a browser, the app now says that, rather than suggesting your link is wrong.

european-ai.title: Interview analysis now runs in Europe
european-ai.body: Transcription and assessment both run on Mistral, a French provider, on European infrastructure. The assessment step used to pass through a router that picked a provider by price; we constrained it, but the guarantee rested on a setting rather than on where the request actually went. There is now one provider and one destination, and a candidate's interview does not leave it.

reliable-reports.title: Reports you can rely on
reliable-reports.body: An interview where one answer fails to transcribe now still produces a report, from the answers that worked, and says on its face that it is missing one — instead of silently producing nothing at all. A quote that cannot be matched against the recording is shown without a play button rather than sent to an approximate moment: if we cannot prove where something was said, we do not pretend to. We have also hardened how share links expire, what leaves our infrastructure, and how completely a deletion deletes.

report-sharing.title: Share a report by link
report-sharing.body: Send one report to a hiring manager without giving them an account. Links expire on a schedule you choose and can be revoked at any time. They show the assessment and the recordings behind it — never your private notes or the candidate’s documents.

async-interviews.title: Asynchronous video interviews
async-interviews.body: Create a role, record your questions on camera, and invite candidates by email. They answer from their browser whenever suits them, and you get a report scored against the criteria you set — with every claim linked to the moment in the video that backs it.
